character.motivation: Believes precise books can protect ordinary people. Has to face what even an accurate ledger can leave out.
character.voice: Exact language, rarely volunteers a feeling directly.
character.backstory: Bram weighed emergency flour deliveries for the bakery during the flood. The totals were correct, but families who picked up supplies under somebody elseâ€™s name disappeared from his records.
character.quest_hook: Compare Maraâ€™s receipts with Bramâ€™s tallies and ask the families how they want their deliveries recorded.

dialogue.introduction: A scale won't tell you what something is worth. It only tells you what you can prove.
dialogue.friendship: When the flour shipment was short, Mara gave me her receipt. She trusted me to count it honestly. I still think about that.
dialogue.supper: I miscounted the bowls because people kept moving over to make room. I'm willing to be wrong about that.
dialogue.hearing: The figures balance. The damage doesn't. A ledger can only do the first part.
dialogue.favorite_gift: That's a sound turnip. I'd buy a crate if they were all like this.
dialogue.disliked_gift: Apples make me think of the shipment we weighed twice. I'll pass.

routine.hobby: Takes a slow lunch at the commons
routine.home_context: Lives close to the bakery that received the flour he weighed during the flood.
